items.title: Expedia Uses Just 11% of Its Profits for Dividends. Could a Bigger Payout Be Coming?
items.summary: Expedia keeps almost every dollar it earns while pouring billions into share buybacks. After a dividend freeze when travel collapsed, the real question is what could force the company to hit pause again.
